thread:
Maria G (CS): quick sync for Fernway private deploy week0. summary: egress failing to our endpoints, KMS key missing Redwood principal, and audit events not appearing in their Splunk. need owners + ETAs. this is on the renewal radar because compliance audit is EOW.
Alex P (Eng): i'll take egress troubleshooting. i see their vpc routes only point to a transit gw but no NAT for private subnets. @Jordan can you confirm the customer subnet CIDRs and whether we have a public egress appliance in their AZ?
Jordan N (Network): customer subnets: 10.20.0.0/16 (app), 10.21.0.0/24 (db). we do have an egress appliance in us-east-1a but route table for 10.20/16 pointed to igw only. i'll add a 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-01234567 route for the private route table and update the security group to allow outbound 443 to our collector IPs. ETA ~30m.
Sam K (Security): KMS: their key policy only allows the account root and a specific IAM user. Redwood needs either the service principal role ARN or a cross-account IAM role. sample snippet they can add to the key policy:

{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}

Sam K (Security): also ask them to enable "grantTokens" in case they are using a lazy-assume pattern; otherwise decryption from our side will fail.
Ira (Ops): i'll check the forwarder and backfill status once egress is fixed. running live tail now to correlate.
deploy-bot: change scheduled 1719999985: update-route-fernway-app-rt (auto-applied).
Alex P (Eng): route change applied. can someone from Fernway validate outbound connectivity? i tested curl -> https://collector.redwood.ai/health and got 200 from a patched instance.
Jordan N (Network): route + sg updates deployed. ran a quick test: outbound to collector IPs shows SYN/ACK.
fernway-pm: replying from PM: we updated the KMS policy per Sams example and rotated our Splunk HEC token earlier which might explain missing logs. i'll push new token to the secure channel.
Ira (Ops): tail shows HEC 401/403 errors: `POST /services/collector/event/1.0 403 HEC token invalid` around 1719999980-1719999988. looks like token rotated during onboarding window. opened reachout to Fernway SRE.
fernway-sre: confirms token rotated. sending new HEC token via our vault and notifying Ops.
Ira (Ops): received token, reloaded forwarder config, logs began arriving at 1719999990. there is a visible ingestion gap ~10m.
Sam K (Security): Verified KMS access: our service can now GenerateDataKey and Decrypt. KMS sign-off complete.
Maria G (CS): excellent. open items: 1) document the 10m log gap for compliance, offer replay if needed; 2) confirm any remaining renewal risk language to commercial team; 3) update onboarding runbook to mention token rotation coordination.
Alex P (Eng): i'll PR the runbook with a new section: "During cutover rotate tokens only in coordination with CS/Ops; provide temporary allowlist for a 15m window" and add KMS policy example.
Jordan N (Network): note for runbook: ensure customers add route for private subnets to NAT/appliance and share CIDRs + AZs in onboarding checklist.
Maria G (CS): i'll message Fernway with the remediation summary and offer to replay logs for their audit evidence. tagging renewal: "medium-high" risk until first compliance audit completes; if there are any further infra slips before Friday, escalate. :warning:
fernway-pm: thanks team. appreciate the quick turn. we'll take the replay and document the token rotation in our compliance change log.
Maria G (CS): closing actions: Alex/Jordan/Ira - confirmed done; Sam - KMS signoff done; CS - follow up with replay offer + update renewal note. scheduling a 30m retro tomorrow to capture lessons learned. :white_check_mark:
